title: Carpenter Overalls - Dark Wash *FINAL SALE*
sourceText: Unisex fit. Vintage workwear inspired with our signature curved top bib with snap pocket for security. Flared leg and stitching like our Carpenter Jeans. It’s made from our super stretchy ComfortDenim that will hug your body and move with you. We took our beloved denim skirt and added a jean jacket-style top to make this clean-finished and super cute style. 74% Cotton 21% Polyester 3% Viscose 2% Elastane Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colors, hang dry

title: Maine Stretch Flannel Shirtdress - Yosemite Plaid
sourceText: This is the fall staple. Comfy, fuzzy stretch flannel will keep you cozy through the chilliest days. It’s the dress version of your favorite Maine Stretch Flannel Shirt. We tailored the body just a touch for a more elevated silhouette. Details include the button placket, chest pockets, hip pockets, button cuffs, and a curved hem. 67% Polyester 28% Rayon 5% Spandex Turn Inside Out, Machine Wash Cold With Like Colors, Gentle Cycle, Do Not Bleach, Do Not Tumble Dry, Lay Flat to Dry, Cool Iron If Needed, Do Not Dry Clean

title: Cooling Stretch Cupro Savannah Dress - Orange Flame
sourceText: We’ve recreated a best-selling dress in our new stretch cupro fabric. It feels smooth as silk but is way easier to care for. As in, it’s machine washable! Supremely comfortable, this western-inspired shirt dress features a stunning sweetheart back yoke, self-belt, and long sleeves. Plus, the pockets include hidden buttons so that the flaps can sit flat and be secured.

title: Rebel Active Shorts - Dove Wing/Deep Brown
sourceText: Designed to keep up with whatever your day brings—from training sessions to errand runs—these shorts deliver all-day performance. A lightweight nylon outer layer adds ease and freedom of movement, while the built-in bike short, crafted from a sweat-wicking, antimicrobial fabric developed by US, helps prevent chafing and provides confident, stay-put coverage. Bonus: the inner layer includes pockets to keep your essentials close while you're on the move.

title: The Refined Lou High Rise Barrel Leg Jeans - Princeton Blue
sourceText: These are the jeans you need right now. High-waisted with a roomy barrel leg. It took five rounds of fittings to perfect this of-the-moment silhouette. With just enough volume that tapers at the ankle, they're made from a structured (but still stretchy) denim that holds its shape. We designed these to be styled two ways—play with sizing to find your favorite fit. Choose your true size if you’re into the oversize look, and size down if you want these jeans to feel fitted through the hips.
